evals.prompt: Audit this site snapshot before our relaunch on Monday and tell me what to fix first. The folder has the raw HTML of each template, urls.csv, robots.txt and the sitemap. Put your full audit in reply.md.
assertions: Finds the noindex page that is listed in the sitemap (copper-kettle)
Finds that /sale is blocked in robots.txt while noindex and in the sitemap, and explains that the noindex cannot be read
Finds the two conflicting canonicals on steel-kettle
Finds that the descale guide is sparse in raw HTML, requires rendered-DOM verification rather than being declared blocked, and has JSON-LD that does not parse
Finds page 2 canonicalised to page 1, or the duplicate titles between them
Ranks indexing-blocking problems above cosmetic ones
Does not present title or description character ranges as a search-engine requirement
Lists what was not checked

evals.prompt: Our pricing page has not shown up in Google for three weeks. Lighthouse gives it SEO 100, so the technical side should be fine, right? Here are the saved HTML, urls.csv, robots.txt and sitemap. What is going on? Put your answer in reply.md.
assertions: Names the canonical pointing to the staging host as a documented strong signal and leading visible candidate, but does not claim it caused the observed absence without selected-canonical or index evidence
Gives the exact corrected canonical tag
Flags max-snippet:0 and what it does
Explains that a lab SEO score of 100 does not cover this
Does not blame the title length or robots.txt for the indexing problem
Says what still has to be checked (index status / search console, staging crawlability or response headers)
Makes no promise about when or whether the page will rank

evals.prompt: Here is our crawler export. The tool's health score is 96, so are we done? Give me the top fixes. Put your answer in reply.md.
assertions: Says no, and that a tool score is not the definition of done
Finds the 3-hop redirect chain starting at /old-tents
Finds the orphan guide pages (0 inlinks)
Finds sitemap entries that are 301, 404 or canonicalised elsewhere
Finds the soft 404 (200 with 'Page not found')
Finds the sort / filter parameter URLs reached by internal links
Quantifies at least three findings and labels project or tool cutoffs (such as redirect hops or click depth) as conventions rather than search-engine requirements
Lists what the export cannot show
